project.name: music-promo-tool
project.os_note: Developed on Windows — all hook scripts invoked via `node` explicitly

allowed_commands.description: Commands Claude can run without asking for confirmation

restricted_commands.description: Commands that always require user confirmation before running

hooks.description: Event-driven automation — all scripts called with `node <script>` for Windows compatibility

pre_commit.description: Runs before every git commit: checks branch protection and runs code review

post_edit.description: Runs after significant code changes: auto-formats Python and TypeScript

dangerous_command.description: Runs before shell commands: blocks destructive operations

code_review.description: Automated code quality check: runs as part of pre-commit and after large edits

mcp_servers.description: Model Context Protocol servers used in this project

playwright.description: Browser automation for testing the web UI — saves hours of manual testing

auto_format.note: Formatting is handled by post-edit.js hook using Node.js fs — no shell `find` needed

e2e.note: Use Playwright MCP via Claude Code for interactive UI testing

windows_notes.paths: Use backslashes in Windows paths (\) or forward slashes — both work in Node.js
windows_notes.hooks: Hooks are invoked as `node <path>` — no chmod or shebang handling needed
windows_notes.shell: Use PowerShell for all manual commands (mkdir, git, npm, pip)
windows_notes.line_endings: Configure git: `git config core.autocrlf true` to avoid CRLF issues
